name: BenchRollOffPlanner
tagline: See every roll-off coming, cut bench time and redeploy consultants faster – one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: A complete bench management app for consultancies and professional-services firms: roll-off timeline, business-day bench ageing and bench cost, at-risk detection, a drag-and-drop redeployment pipeline, bulk actions, a validated create/edit form and Power Fx outputs and events. Works instantly with demo data and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or collections in canvas apps, to model-driven subgrids and to Power Pages through the Web API.
features: Bench cost to date and projected
Status transition rules and required fields
Drag and drop + keyboard stage moves
Bulk assign manager / set stage / training
Read-only, empty, loading, error and map-your-columns states
